Landing.heroTitle: One platform for every Malaysian SME niche
Landing.heroSubtitle: Allvisor adapts CRM, bookings, POS, inventory, invoicing, light accounting and LHDN e-Invoice to your business type — clinic, shop, salon, workshop and more.
Landing.chooseBusinessHint: Menu and features follow your niche. One organisation = one niche, so dashboards stay clean and isolated.
Landing.clinicDesc: Appointments, patients, allergies/risk, treatment invoices and clinic hours.
Landing.retailDesc: POS, cash drawer, stock, logistics, receipts, categories and printers.
Landing.salonDesc: Appointments plus product sales, staff commissions and service bookings.
Landing.pharmacyDesc: Full retail POS with batch/lot tracking, expiry alerts and controlled-item flags.
Landing.opticalDesc: Eye prescriptions, frame inventory, lab orders and walk-in sales.
Landing.tuitionDesc: Class schedules, attendance, term fees and parent/student CRM.
Landing.workshopDesc: Job cards, vehicle profiles, parts from inventory and invoicing.
Landing.gymDesc: Memberships, class check-ins, PT sessions and fee invoices.
Landing.vetDesc: Pet profiles, vaccinations, appointments and owner CRM.
Landing.fashionDesc: POS with size/colour variants, stock and retail ops.
Landing.electronicsDesc: POS with IMEI/serial tracking for phones, devices and accessories.
Landing.wholesaleDesc: Customer price tiers, bulk sales, logistics and inventory.
Landing.laundryDesc: Ticket flow for drop-off/pickup plus simple product sales.
Landing.physioDesc: Appointments, session packages, patient notes and invoices.
Landing.labDesc: Appointments, diagnostics results and billing for lab tests.
Landing.fnbDesc: Tables & KOT starter, POS, cash drawer and inventory.
Landing.hotelDesc: Room types, occupancy tracking and guest invoicing.
Landing.propertyDesc: Listings, client CRM and invoices for agencies or managers.
Landing.courierDesc: Shipment tracking, customers and delivery billing.
Landing.contractorDesc: Project claims, progress billing and client records.
Landing.manufacturingDesc: Work orders, BOM/WIP basics and inventory control.
Landing.legalDesc: Matter billing, client files and professional invoices.
Landing.eventsDesc: Event timelines, client CRM and package invoicing.
Landing.farmDesc: Plots, produce inventory and farm business billing.

Appointments.title: Appointments
Appointments.bookHint: Select a day → tap a thick hour line (start) → tap a thick/thin line (end) → choose patient → book. Red/grey times cannot be selected.
Appointments.pickStart: Tap a free start line (thick = hour, thin = :30)
Appointments.pickEnd: Tap a free end line (thick = hour, thin = :30)
Appointments.completeConfirm2: Confirm again: status becomes completed and a pending invoice is added. Go to Invoices to open it.

Invoices.title: Invoices
Invoices.cancelLhdnPrompt: Reason for cancelling this e-Invoice on MyInvois (required):
Invoices.searchPlaceholder: Search customer, invoice no., category, service, notes…
Invoices.exitWarn: You need to submit invoice first. Are you sure u want to exit?
Invoices.exitReasonTitle: Are you sure want to exit?
Invoices.exitReasonHint: Invoice is not fully paid yet. If yes, please enter the reason below. This will be saved in invoice activity.
Invoices.exitReasonPlaceholder: Reason for leaving without full payment…
Invoices.howNumber: Invoice no. = unique system ID (auto like INV-2026-00001, or your custom number). Each row needs a unique number.
Invoices.howName: Invoice name = friendly label for staff/patients (e.g. "Consultation Ahmad"). Same name can appear more than once.
Invoices.howNameRetail: Invoice name = friendly label for staff/customers (e.g. "Order ProSupply"). Same name can appear more than once.
Invoices.howStatus: When you change status (Paid / Unpaid), Allvisor adds a new list row with the same invoice name and the new status — so you can see both Paid and Unpaid entries in the list.

InvoiceDetail.editStatusHint: Choosing a new status adds another invoice row in the list with the same name and the new status (e.g. one Paid + one Unpaid).
InvoiceDetail.extrasHint: Add optional medicine/additional costs. Product/service and service charge stay on the bill.
InvoiceDetail.extrasHintRetail: Add optional product extras or additional costs. Line items and service charge stay on the bill.
InvoiceDetail.noInventory: No stocked items in Inventory yet. Add items there first.
InvoiceDetail.submitLhdnHint: Paid status only records payment in Allvisor. Press this to send the e-Invoice to MyInvois (sandbox or production per env).
InvoiceDetail.submitLhdnPlanLocked: Your plan does not include LHDN e-Invoice. Upgrade in Admin.
InvoiceDetail.submitLhdnNeedTin: Set your business TIN on the LHDN e-Invoice page first.
InvoiceDetail.submitLhdnAlready: Already Valid on MyInvois ({status}). Use refresh if you need the latest status.
InvoiceDetail.cancelLhdnHint: Cancel this e-Invoice on MyInvois (usually within 72 hours after Valid). Reason is required.
InvoiceDetail.cancelLhdnPrompt: Reason for cancelling this e-Invoice on MyInvois (required):

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.subtitle: Manage categories, services, staff, plans and branches.
Admin.superSubtitle: Monitor and manage every linked branch in expandable groups.
Admin.lockHint: Admin page is locked. Default password = clinic/business name (no spaces) + year the account was created.
Admin.categoriesHint: Create categories first. Description is optional.
Admin.servicesHint: Assign each service to a category, set price, and optional description.
Admin.servicesHintRetail: Optional catalog items for invoices (inventory stock is managed separately).
Admin.needCategoryFirst: Add at least one category before creating services.
Admin.addMemberHint: Enter a registered Allvisor email to add them as staff / supervisor / manager / co-admin. One account can only join one shop. Owner cannot be kicked.
Admin.addMemberHintTuition: Enter a registered Allvisor email to add them as staff / supervisor / manager / co-admin. One account can only join one tuition centre. Owner cannot be kicked.
Admin.addBranchHint: Enter the exact Allvisor clinic name of another branch (register that clinic separately first). If you are admin of both, it links immediately and appears in the branch list below. Otherwise their admin must approve.
Admin.addBranchHintRetail: Enter the exact Allvisor shop name of another branch (register that shop separately first). If you are admin of both, it links immediately. Otherwise their admin must approve.
Admin.addBranchHintTuition: Enter the exact Allvisor tuition centre name of another branch (register that tuition separately first). If you are admin of both, it links immediately and appears in the branch list below. Otherwise their admin must approve.
Admin.businessSettingsHint: Clinic / shop identity used on invoices and LHDN.
Admin.businessSettingsHintTuition: Tuition centre identity used on invoices and LHDN.
Admin.logoHint: Upload a logo, zoom/pan to crop, then pick round or square. Live previews show both frames before you save.
Admin.logoDragHint: Choose an image, then drag to position and zoom to crop
Admin.invoiceFormatHint: Controls auto invoice numbers. Customize prefix, digits, and the full pattern.
Admin.scorecardHint: Compare income, unpaid invoices, appointments and no-shows across linked clinics.
Admin.scorecardHintRetail: Compare income, unpaid invoices, transactions and low stock across linked shops.
Admin.scorecardHintTuition: Compare income, unpaid invoices and activity across linked tuition centres.
Admin.activityHint: Tracks staff actions visible to admins and supervisors.
Admin.serviceChargeHint: Applied automatically on every invoice as service tax (shown in small text before total).
Admin.clinicHoursHint: Per-branch settings. Controls Dashboard and Appointments timetables for this clinic. Last hour shown = closing hour.
Admin.tuitionHoursHint: Per-branch settings. Controls Dashboard and Schedule timetables for this tuition. Last hour shown = closing hour.
Admin.shopSettingsHint: Per-branch service charge applied on invoices for this shop.
Admin.tuitionSettingsHint: Per-branch service charge applied on invoices for this tuition centre.
Admin.holidayNote: Malaysian public holidays are auto-highlighted on the timetable for nurses to check.
Admin.holidayNoteTuition: Malaysian public holidays are auto-highlighted on the timetable for staff to check.
Admin.importTitle: Import old data from other software
Admin.importHint: Export CSV or Excel from your old clinic software, then upload here to migrate into Allvisor.
Admin.importHintRetail: Export CSV or Excel from your old shop software, then upload here to migrate into Allvisor.
Admin.importHintTuition: Export CSV or Excel from your old tuition software, then upload here to migrate into Allvisor.
Admin.importSteps: 1) Download Allvisor template  2) Copy your old data into matching columns  3) Upload & import.
Admin.importOrderHint: Recommended order: Patients → Service categories → Service items → Products → Appointments.
Admin.importOrderHintRetail: Recommended order: Customers → Product categories → Inventory products → Suppliers → Past sales / receipts.
Admin.importNoRows: No data rows found in the file.
Admin.importPartial: Import finished with some skipped rows

Lhdn.title: LHDN e-Invoice
Lhdn.subtitle: Allvisor submits e-Invoices to MyInvois as your authorized intermediary. Each shop uses its own TIN.
Lhdn.subtitleTuition: Allvisor submits e-Invoices to MyInvois as your authorized intermediary. Each tuition centre uses its own TIN.
Lhdn.brnHelp: For IG (individual) TIN: enter your NRIC from MyInvois Taxpayer Profile (ID Number). For company TIN (C…): enter ROB/ROC.
Lhdn.linkedConfirm: I authorized {name} as my intermediary in the MyInvois portal (Representatives → Intermediaries).
Lhdn.howTitle: How this works for your shop
Lhdn.howTitleTuition: How this works for your tuition centre
Lhdn.howStep1: Enter your Tax Identification Number (TIN) below and save.
Lhdn.howStep2: Log in to MyInvois → Representatives → Intermediaries → add {name}.
Lhdn.howStep3: Tick the confirmation that you authorized {name}, then save.
Lhdn.howStep4: Submit invoices from Allvisor — they go to LHDN under your TIN.
Lhdn.howNote: {name} holds one platform API credential. Your Client Secret is never required.
Lhdn.lockedPlan: Your plan does not include e-Invoice. Upgrade in Admin to unlock.
Lhdn.intermediaryConnected: Intermediary mode: {name} submits on behalf of each shop’s TIN via MyInvois.
Lhdn.intermediaryConnectedTuition: Intermediary mode: {name} submits on behalf of each tuition centre’s TIN via MyInvois.
Lhdn.demoMode: Demo mode: set LHDN_CLIENT_ID and LHDN_CLIENT_SECRET in env (platform intermediary credentials) to use real MyInvois.
